independent_command_check: I is a conditional continuing crew-document exemption with crew-list visa requirements and future-order incorporation; II imposes a recurring passenger-document parity rule; III requires advance notice to State so Treasury and Labor may be advised; the next paragraph independently authorizes State and Labor to issue consistent implementing rules; the final paragraph makes the order supplementary and immediately effective. Immediate effectiveness is a self-executing legal transition, not proof of later administrative performance or whole-order exhaustion.
